stimulus.text: The photograph, taken on October 16, 1907, shows the Great Cahokia Mound, also called Monks Mound, rising above a cultivated field near present-day St. Louis, Missouri. The mound was built by the Mississippian people around 1100, long before European contact.
stimulus.source_note: Photograph from the shared image pool; Library of Congress photograph, October 16, 1907, public domain.

parts.prompt: Identify what the mound in the photograph shows about Cahokia.
Explain how maize farming made building on this scale possible.
Explain one limitation of using this 1907 photograph as evidence about life at Cahokia around 1100.

instruction: Answer each part in your own words from the stimulus only. Do not open the question file.
